narrative: A player's roll unrolled on a bench, cue-words set to the right of a long rule, the speeches under them. Three cues are newly written. The older cue is struck at those three places only. A second roll lies beside it, already recopied, the hand not yours. One surface.

entities.name: Humphrey Larkham
entities.context: Named by the second roll in his hand. Not pictured.

entities.name: Richard the Third
entities.context: Shown on part in The three words on the roll
